about: teacher_training Amendment 6 (reports/plans/2026-10-23_plan_teacher-training.md -> 'Amendment 6'): gaps 10, 7, 6 and 4 of reports/reviews/2026-10-28_review_technique-comparison.md in one RunPod H100 job. Teachers regenerated in-job: arm-A fine-tunes of all 24 matrices (seed 0, step 1000; r1 SGD 0.03 and Adam 3e-5, r2_t275_v2667 SGD 0.1) and E9's rank-8 LoRA (amend3.lora_teacher) on emoticon, r1, r0. Students use E34's recipes (run.CFG): A task windows, B Pile train rows 32,768-40,959 (batch 8, plain mean KL), both Adam 1e-5; S task windows with plain SGD 0.03. E34's earlier predictions files stand unedited. Filed before any run

controls.C1: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check; expected pass, floor about 0.075 on the H100. Fails: stop
controls.G1: the r1 SGD teacher (fine-tune seed 0, step 1000) reads P within 0.01 of 0.9834 and size within 0.003 of 0.02875 (E34, A4, A5), and its do-nothing adversarial ratio is within 0.03 of 1.588 (E34 and A5 read 1.5884). Fails: stop. Every other teacher's reading is checked against its same-card reference and reported
controls.G3: stage c, first: arm S on the r1 SGD teacher at step 1000 reads 'fail' with P within 0.02 of 0.9857 (E34: 3.14). Fails: the two new S arms are skipped and P4 reads 'unreadable'
controls.W0_plain_text: W0's plain-text damage KL(W0 || W0) over the 256 rows <= 1e-4 (expected 0: two identical forward passes). Fails: stop (every damage reading would carry the paths' difference)
controls.r2_gate: the r2 teacher's held-out P(target) >= 0.5 at step 1000, else its students are skipped and P2, P3 read 'not run' (no SGD 0.1 full-weight fine-tune of r2 has been read; E21's Adam 3e-5 one read 0.82)

expected.S: the SGD teacher's S: 'fail' at 1000 (E34 3.14), pass at 100; window damage 1.2x the teacher's
expected.W0: pile_damage 0; every ratio 1; P(target) 0.004 emoticon, 0.15 r0, 0.04 r1, 0.0034 r2
expected.a_students: P 0.97-1.0 at step 1000 (E34, A3); task-window damage 0.55-0.97x the teacher's for full-weight teachers, 2.1x for the r1 LoRA's student A (A3)
expected.adjoint: plain-text damage below the teacher's (E31 A3 and E34 on windows: 0.38-0.55x on r1)
expected.d: seed 0 at step 1000 reproduces A3's P 0.567, 0.875, 0.521 (emoticon, r1, r0) within about 0.03 (reported)
expected.do_nothing: pile_gap 0 by construction (positive control of the gap); pile_damage of each teacher same order as its task-window damage (r1 SGD 0.056, Adam 0.076, LoRA 0.015; no reference on plain text)
expected.noise: A4's batch-order spread: P within 0.032 (Pile-text students), adversarial ratio within 25%; C1's floor

measurements.curve: every student's training curve at step 100 and every 250 steps: free held-out P(target) and damage, and the means over the last 50 steps of P and of the training loss
measurements.harness: E34's seven numbers per state (run.read_state): adversarial and stochastic ratios to this job's W0 (adversary seed 0), verdict (state_verdict, P bar 0.9), held-out P(target), teacher gap, damage on task windows, size, Delta's share. 'faith' = state_verdict on the two ratios with no P bar
measurements.plain_text: pile_damage = mean over every position of the 256 Pile val rows (the harness's rows) of KL(W0 || state), the state being the target model at W0 + its delta-W; pile_gap = the same of KL(teacher || state). finetune.eval_arm_b, bf16 autocast, KL in fp32. Held fixed: rows, Gamma, Delta. Blind to harm the 256 rows do not sample and to damage in the masked model; no batch-order spread exists for it (the 2x bar is wide for that reason). Positive control: each teacher's own pile_damage > 0

not_run: the r2 Adam 3e-5 teacher (one teacher keeps stage b short; E21 read that fine-tune at P 0.82 on an L40); r2 S
arm S at a second batch order, on emoticon or r0, or at step-100 harness reads
the adversary on stage a's students (E34 and A4 read them); harness reads of the LoRA and Adam do-nothing states (E34, A3 read them on this card)
student B past 5,000 steps or on more than 8,192 Pile rows; seed 1 past 2,500 steps
a longer adversary or more adversary starts (decided 2026-10-27: one start, 20 steps)

predictions.confidence: high on the four full-weight students; low on the LoRA student
predictions.predicted: holds on all five (E34 windows: 0.55-0.97x); the LoRA student read 2.1x on windows, so it may not
predictions.reported: each ratio, the scaled adjoint states' ratios, the S and r2 and (d) states' plain-text damage
predictions.rule: for each of r1's SGD-teacher A and B, Adam-teacher A and B, and LoRA-teacher A students at step 1000 (seed 0): pile_damage <= 2 x its teacher's do-nothing pile_damage, or <= 0.002 nats absolute; pass = all five present and holding

predictions.confidence: medium-low (component training never passed r2 cleanly: E11, E21, E26)
predictions.predicted: kept and faithful (E34: every A student within 0.08 of its teacher and passing)
predictions.rule: r2 student A at step 1000: 'kept' = P(target) >= the teacher's P - 0.05; 'faithful' = faith 'pass'; category kept and faithful / faithful, not kept / kept, not faithful / neither; pass = kept and faithful

predictions.lean: kept and faithful (the cue ' in' is common on the Pile, as r0's and r1's are)
predictions.rule: as P2 for student B (Pile rows) at step 1000

predictions.lean: map: SGD on (U, V) fails late on r1 whatever its teacher (E21, E26 component training; E34 arm S)
predictions.reported: P(target) at step 100 (free reading) and the size of each S state (E21: SGD fails above about 0.009)
predictions.rule: arm S at step 1000 on the r1 Adam and LoRA teachers, verdict per teacher: 'fail' -> map, 'pass' -> teacher, 'inconclusive' -> between, 'below P 0.9' -> not learnt; overall map if both map, teacher if both teacher, else mixed; needs G3; pass = map

predictions.confidence: medium on emoticon and r1; none on r0
predictions.predicted: emoticon learnt, r1 learnt (A3 at 1000: 0.567 rising from 0.076, 0.875 from 0.756); r0 not predicted (0.462 -> 0.521)
predictions.reported: pile_gap / the teacher's pile_damage at 1000, 2500, 5000 (how much of the teacher's plain-text change the student has taken), the curves, damage
predictions.rule: student B of each LoRA teacher at seed 0, step 5000: 'learnt' if P >= 0.9 and verdict 'pass'; 'learnt, not passed' if P >= 0.9 otherwise; else 'plateau' if the 50-step mean P rose by less than 0.03 from step 2500 to 5000, 'rising' if not; pass = emoticon and r1 both learnt

predictions.predicted: holds on all three (A4: Pile-text students of full-weight teachers within 0.032 and 25%)
predictions.rule: per task, student B at seed 1 against seed 0 at step 2500: |P1 - P0| <= 0.05 and |ratio1 / ratio0 - 1| <= 0.25 (Amendment 4's P2 rule); pass = all three tasks
